definition: The Commission’s count of Single Market directives whose transposition deadline had passed without the Member State notifying complete transposition measures: directives with no measures notified, directives considered partially transposed, and directives the Member State considers transposed but on which the Commission has opened a non-communication case with no new measures notified since its latest step. Single Market directives are those considered to have an impact on the functioning of the Single Market (Article 26(2) TFEU); other directives are not counted.
label: Overdue Single Market directives
period: Notifications made by 5 December 2025, for directives with a transposition deadline on or before 30 November 2025
